# Account Deletion

PrayCalc lets you delete your account and all associated data at any time, from within the app. This page explains what gets deleted, how to do it, and what to do first if you have an active subscription.

## What gets deleted

When you delete your account, the following data is permanently removed:

- Your profile and display name
- Saved locations and city favorites
- Notification preferences and alert settings
- Prayer tracking history
- Smart home device connections and automations
- TV pairing data
- Any Ummat+ subscription entitlement (account-side — see subscription note below)

Deletion is permanent. It cannot be undone.

## Before you delete

**Active subscriptions:** Deleting your account does not automatically cancel your subscription through the App Store or Google Play. To avoid future charges, cancel your subscription first:

- **iOS:** Settings app > [your name] > Subscriptions > PrayCalc > Cancel
- **Android:** Google Play app > Profile icon > Payments & subscriptions > Subscriptions > PrayCalc > Cancel

After cancelling, you keep access until the end of the current billing period. You can then delete your account.

## How to delete your account

1. Open PrayCalc on iOS or Android
2. Go to **Settings**
3. Tap **Account**
4. Tap **Delete Account**
5. Confirm when prompted

Deletion takes effect immediately. A confirmation email is sent to your registered address.

## Web (praycalc.com)

Account deletion from the web is available at [praycalc.com/account/delete](https://praycalc.com/account/delete). Sign in first, then follow the on-screen steps.

## Data export

You can download a copy of your data before deleting. In Settings > Account, tap **Download My Data**. A JSON file with your locations, preferences, and prayer history is prepared and sent to your email within 24 hours.

## Contact

If you have trouble deleting your account, email [support@praycalc.com](mailto:support@praycalc.com) with your registered email address and we will process the deletion manually within 48 hours.
